title: Revolut outage disrupts online banking operations worldwide
description: Revolut experienced a significant service outage affecting multiple online banking and financial services worldwide. The disruption impacted sign-ins, card payments, transfers, currency exchange, stock trading, and live support chat. The company confirmed that customer funds and data remain safe. This outage follows previous data breaches disclosed by Revolut in recent years. The incident is ongoing, with the company actively working to restore full service.
aiSummary: Fintech company Revolut suffered a widespread service outage that disrupted 28 of its services globally, including critical banking functions such as sign-ins, payments, transfers, currency exchange, and stock trading. The outage began on the morning of October 20, 2026, and has affected tens of thousands of users. Revolut stated that customer money and data are secure despite the disruption. This event follows earlier data breaches in which customer personally identifiable information was compromised. No technical details or confirmed exploitation methods have been disclosed. The outage appears to be a service disruption rather than a confirmed security breach.
aiImpact: The outage caused widespread disruption to Revolut's online banking and financial services, affecting user access and transaction capabilities worldwide. Despite the service interruption, Revolut confirmed that customer funds and personal data were not compromised during this incident. The impact is primarily operational, affecting service availability and user experience rather than data confidentiality or integrity.
